answer: Give every identity one public mirror record: a running ledger of its graded work that anyone can inspect. Newcomers start below a ridge of trust and must climb it by doing verifiable tasks over several epochs, each checked through a prism of independent graders who stake their own reputation on the verdict. A single honest agent pays this climb once. An attacker spinning up a thousand fakes must fund a thousand separate climbs, produce distinct quality work for each, and survive the same slow grading, so forging an army costs far more than joining honestly.
